title: Claude Mythos
raw_excerpt: 'Mythos' is the name for a new tier of Anthropic models that are larger and more intelligent than Opus. The models get dramatically higher scores on tests of software coding, academic reasoning, and cybersecurity compared to Claude Opus 4.6. Mythos is a large, compute-intensive model that is very expensive to use and serve. Anthropic is working on making the model much more efficient before any general release.
summary: Anthropic 推出名为“Mythos”的新模型层级，性能超越 Opus 4.6，在编程、学术推理和网络安全测试中大幅领先。Mythos 是计算密集型大模型，目前成本极高，Anthropic 正在优化效率，尚未公开发布。该消息揭示了前沿模型的最新进展。

title: Qwen3.5-Omni: Scaling Up, Toward Native Omni-Modal AGI
raw_excerpt: Qwen3.5-Omni is a full omnimodal large language model that understands text, images, audio, and audio-visual content. It can process more than 10 hours of audio input and over 400 seconds of 720P audio-visual input at 1 FPS. The model is trained on a massive amount of text and visual data, and more than 100 million hours of audio-visual data. It supports speech recognition in 113 languages and dialects and speech generation in 36 languages and dialects.
summary: 阿里通义千问发布 Qwen3.5-Omni 全模态大模型，支持文本、图像、音频和音视频理解，可处理超10小时音频输入和400秒720P视频。模型基于超1亿小时音视频数据训练，支持113种语言语音识别和36种语言语音生成，标志着全模态AI的重要进展。

title: TRL v1.0: Post-Training Library Built to Move with the Field
summary: Hugging Face 发布 TRL v1.0，这是一个用于大语言模型后训练（post-training）的库，支持强化学习、DPO、PPO 等技术。该库旨在与领域发展同步，为研究人员和开发者提供标准化工具，加速模型对齐和微调工作。

title: Meta tests Avocado 9B, Avocado Mango Agent, and more
raw_excerpt: Meta's Avocado model has been pushed back to at least May as it still falls short of leading systems from competitors. The company appears to be running parallel experiments with multiple Avocado variants. The model appears to be able to solve complex math problems that earlier Llama models could not, but these problems have already been solved by other labs months earlier. Meta's AI leadership has reportedly discussed temporarily licensing Google's Gemini technology. Some requests within Meta AI are already being routed through Gemini models.
summary: Meta 的 Avocado 9B 模型发布推迟至5月，性能仍落后于竞品。Meta 正并行测试多个变体，包括 Avocado Mango Agent。内部消息称 Meta 曾讨论临时授权 Google Gemini 技术，部分请求已路由至 Gemini 模型，反映 Meta 在 AI 竞赛中的压力。

title: Universal Claude.md – cut Claude output tokens
summary: GitHub 上出现一个名为“Universal Claude.md”的开源项目，旨在通过优化提示词结构减少 Claude 输出 token 消耗。该项目提供通用模板，帮助用户更高效地使用 Claude，降低 API 成本，受到开发者社区广泛关注（471 点赞）。

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot gets Critique and Council modes
raw_excerpt: Microsoft 365 Copilot has introduced Critique and Council modes to enhance research capabilities. Critique uses a dual-model system to generate and refine research drafts, outperforming single-model solutions by 13.88% on the DRACO benchmark. Council allows parallel report generation using Anthropic and OpenAI models for impactful comparison and insight aggregation.
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot 新增 Critique 和 Council 模式。Critique 使用双模型系统生成并优化研究草稿，在 DRACO 基准上性能提升 13.88%；Council 模式可并行调用 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 模型生成报告，便于对比和聚合洞察，增强企业级 AI 研究能力。

title: TAPS: Task Aware Proposal Distributions for Speculative Sampling
summary: 新论文提出 TAPS（Task Aware Proposal Distributions for Speculative Sampling），一种任务感知的推测解码方法。通过为不同任务定制提议分布，TAPS 在保持生成质量的同时显著加速 LLM 推理，为高效部署大模型提供了新思路。

title: Towards a Medical AI Scientist
summary: 论文《Towards a Medical AI Scientist》探索构建能自主进行医学研究的 AI 系统，涵盖文献阅读、假设生成、实验设计和结果分析。该工作展示了 AI 在科学发现中的潜力，但面临可重复性和伦理挑战，引发学界广泛讨论（89 点赞）。

title: Mistral secures $830M in debt financing to fund AI data center
summary: 法国 AI 公司 Mistral 获得 8.3 亿美元债务融资，用于在欧洲建设基于 Nvidia 芯片的 AI 数据中心。这是欧洲 AI 基础设施领域最大规模融资之一，显示 Mistral 在算力竞争中的扩张野心，也反映欧洲在 AI 基础设施投资上的加速。

title: Codex Plugin for Claude Code
summary: OpenAI 发布 Codex 插件，可集成到 Claude Code 工作流中。该插件允许用户在 Claude Code 中直接调用 Codex 进行代码审查、对抗性测试或二次检查，实现跨平台 AI 编码协作，标志着两大 AI 公司工具链的互操作尝试。
